statement: Any contract or agreement with an employee (including a contractor or consultant) that governs the use of a trade secret or other confidential information must include notice of the whistleblower immunity in 18 U.S.C. § 1833(b)(1); an employer that omits the notice cannot recover exemplary damages or attorney fees in a Defend Trade Secrets Act action against the employee to whom notice was not provided (18 U.S.C. § 1833(b)(1), (3)-(4)).
caveat: The notice can be given by cross-referencing a policy document provided to the worker. The omission costs remedies, not the claim itself. This repo does not draft agreements.
